statement: There are nonnegative folded vectors md(x) char- acterized by ϕmd (x) = X L wL dim Y d (EL(x)). (2.13) They have finite level support. Each individual coordinate ranges over a locally finite subset of R≥0. Weighted counts of tops and socles of the layers are likewise proportional within a color: a nonzero top or socle in that color occurs at every unfolded vertex of the color in some member of the family. The same proportionality holds for families of subobjects obtained functorially by twists and layer truncations. If only colors of T ⊆ S act, all generator spaces with their cochain and internal placements outside e T stay unchanged up to isomorphism.
